subject: Software Engineering
moduleTitle: Unit 5 — Object-Oriented Analysis, UML 2.5 Metamodel & Use Case Engineering
moduleDescription: In-depth investigation of Object-Oriented Analysis (OOA) paradigms (Encapsulation, Information Hiding, Abstraction, Generalization/Specialization, Inheritance, and Dynamic Polymorphism), the UML 2.5 Metamodel architecture (Things, Relationships, and Multi-View Diagrams), formal Use Case modeling (Primary vs. Secondary Actors, Cockburn Scenario Structures, System Boundary Scoping), advanced UML stereotypes (<<include>> mandatory subroutine reuse vs. <<extend>> optional conditional insertion), and systematic requirements discovery techniques (User Goal Technique, Comprehensive Event Decomposition across External/Temporal/State events, and the CRUD Lifecycle Cross-Verification Matrix).
